text:
maya: Heads up — we bumped eu-west-1 clusters to k8s 1.31 earlier and I'm seeing the autoscaler not spinning up GPU nodes for a couple of ML jobs.
sahil: Which symptom exactly? pods pending or nodes stuck in NotReady?
maya: Pods pending with "0/6 nodes are available: 6 Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu" even though node-pool shows spare quota.
kevin: Is the cluster-autoscaler reporting any scale-up attempt in logs? can you paste recent lines?
maya: Paste below from the scaler logs (filtered):
```
E0314 08:12:21.123 autoscaler.go:456] Scale-up failed: failed to find node group for expansion: provisioner.k8s.io/v1alpha1 Provisioner not found
I0314 08:12:21.124 logic.go:98] Pod x requests 2 nvidia.com/gpu, matching template gpu-sku-a
```
lorna: Hmm that Provisioner API group name changed in 1.31 to provisioning.k8s.io/v1beta1 in our new node-controller CRD. Autoscaler still querying old API path.
sahil: Ohhh, we did have a CRD rename during the upgrade. The new provisioner controller kept a different CRD name for backward compat but the old apiVersion removed the shortname.
kevin: That would explain the "not found" — autoscaler treats that as no matching nodegroup so it refuses to expand capacity.
maya: Confirmed: `kubectl get provisioner -A` returns nothing, but `kubectl get provisionings -A` shows our templates.
ops-bot: <deploy-bot> Canary rollout for k8s-controlplane completed in eu-west-1 at 08:05 UTC :white_check_mark:
lorna: Quick mitigation: modify autoscaler config to fallback to label-based discovery. There's a hidden feature we added last year — set `--nodegroup-lookup=label` to bypass the CRD discovery for now.
sahil: Can we hotpatch the autoscaler in the cluster? We have a canary pool where we can rollout a new image with that flag.
kevin: I pushed a deployment with `--nodegroup-lookup=label` to canary-autoscaler (eu-west-1) and restarted. Logs now show:
```
I0314 08:14:02.002 discovery.go:72] Using label-based nodegroup discovery
I0314 08:14:02.315 scaleup_estimator.go:210] Estimated new nodes: 1 (gpu-sku-a)
```
maya: After the patch some pending pods were scheduled and one new GPU node provisioned. Latency for scheduled jobs dropped from 35s queue to ~6s. :tada:
lorna: We should make a follow-up: either restore backward-compat alias CRD or update autoscaler to check both apiVersions. Also verify other regions.
sahil: Agreed. I'll open a ticket and tag platform and oncall. Quick TODOs: 1) rollout flag to all clusters, 2) update autoscaler code to probe both APIs, 3) coordinate with provisioning-controller to add compatibility webhook.
kevin: Also audit other components that may query `provisioner.k8s.io` (monitoring, cost-accounting) — they might be silently failing and causing capacity reporting drift.
maya: I'll run a quick query for any references in cluster config repos.
ops-bot: <incident-bot> Incident draft created: INC-2026-03314-autoscaler-provisioner-api (severity: low, assigned: sahil)
lorna: Nice catch, Maya. Let's keep this thread for timeline notes. If anything breaks in other regions ping here. :eyes:
